title: Misty Step does not move the caster
steps: fresh; cast misty-step at x=205 y=287 charge=2; wait 2; cell at my position (no x,y)
happened: Log says 'You cast Misty Step' but I stay at 198,287 (cell reports 198,287 grass). Same after casts at 10,3 (7 cells), 9,2 (charge 3) and 50,3 (out of range); I never moved.
expected: Blurb: 'Blink up to 60 ft ... to a square you can see'. A target 7 cells away should take the caster there.
evidence: Tool output: 'Cast. 205,287 grass, height 0 / log: You cast Misty Step'; then cell with no args: '198,287 grass, height 0' (position unchanged).

title: Frozen water cells persist for thousands of ticks with no heat
steps: fresh; create-water at 202,280 charge 3; ray-of-frost at 202,280 charge 3; wait to tick 3900; census r6 at 202,280.
happened: 3 frozen water cells stayed frozen from tick 300 to tick 3900. Nearby liquid water drained from 124 to 0 meanwhile.
expected: Ice should melt back to water over time, or at least not outlast its water.
evidence: census r6 at 202,280: tick 300 frozen:water=3 liquid:water=124; tick 2400 frozen:water=3 liquid:water=21; tick 3900 frozen:water=3 with no liquid water.
